messages:
Priya (Billing): Found an issue in March invoice run: VAT lines ending up twice and some invoices with negative final balance when reserved_capacity credits are applied. Need immediate triage.
Ken (Eng): Can you paste the job id and a log snippet?
Priya (Billing): job invoice-run-2026-03-22-23. Snip from pipeline:
```
lines:
  - reserved_capacity_credit: -150.00
  - usage_compute: 150.00
  - vat: 0.00
  - vat: 30.00
```
Priya (Billing): Looks like credits nullified the taxable base in one path and the tax-service still calculated on gross in another, producing two VAT lines. A few invoices show balance -30.00.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-03-22-23 completed with 19 warnings, 4 errors. Errors: TAX_DUPLICATION, STRIPE_DRAFT_BLOCK.
Marco (Payments): If Stripe sees negative totals we may get rejected drafts; that causes webhook noise and manual cleanup.
Lena (Revenue Ops): Are these duplicate VAT lines across invoices or just within the same invoice?
Priya (Billing): Within same invoice. Affected: 12 EU customers, 2 enterprise. We'll need to pause the Stripe export for this batch.
Ken (Eng): I'll add a short-term exporter guard: reject invoices with negative totals and mark for manual review. Also dedupe tax lines by tax_code before export. I can PR the guard now.
Priya (Billing): Please pause exports immediately. Finance will not send statements until reconciled. Also need CSV of affected invoice ids for Sales outreach.
Lena (Revenue Ops): After fix, we'll re-export only impacted invoices. We'll prepare credit memos for any customers who were overbilled.
Ken (Eng): Root cause likely race between apply_credits and tax-service. Long-term fix: compute taxes on final net lines in one service. Short-term: dedupe tax codes and assert total == sum(lines)+sum(taxes).
Marco (Payments): Confirming Stripe idempotency will help on re-run, but drafts need manual checks.
Priya (Billing): I'll compile the list of invoice ids and owners and post to #sales-ops. Target: customer notice within 24h, full remediation in 48h.
Ken (Eng): Will add unit test and deploy a canary. Quick guard out in ~90 min, full fix tomorrow AM.
Priya (Billing): Thanks all. Holding exports now. I'll post customer message draft shortly. :thumbsup:
